findings.description: The bucket has no acl attribute set and is explicitly noted as public with no encryption, versioning, or logging configured, exposing its contents (including a customer master file) to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in public unencrypted bucket
findings.description: A customer master file (customer-master.xlsx), likely containing sensitive PII, is uploaded into the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized read/write and tampering.
The financials bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest despite the bucket being private.
The operations bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
The data_science bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest despite having logging and versioning configured.
